instruction: Select the transaction with the greatest value and mark it with a colored background.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the largest amount (9444 at D13) and highlighting it. Verified with Python: max value is 9444 at row 13. Evaluator checks if cell D13 has any fill color applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both task requirements: (1) correct cell identified as having max value (D13 = 9444), and (2) cell has highlighting applied
Getter logic correctly extracts cell fill color using openpyxl, properly filtering out default/transparent colors (00000000, FFFFFFFF)
Metric correctly handles rule-type expected parameter by directly accessing expected.get('has_fill') and expected.get('cell') - proper framework usage
Metric performs dual verification: checks both cell location (D13) AND presence of fill color
Expected value is semantically correct - metadata confirms D13 contains max value (9444) verified with Python
Postconfig properly configured to activate window, save file, and ensure fresh state for verification
Data flow is correct: getter extracts cell fill info -> metric compares location and fill status -> expected specifies D13 with has_fill=true
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Very minor edge case: getter filters out white color (FFFFFFFF) as 'no fill', but technically white could be an intentional highlight color. This is acceptable for practical purposes since white is typically the default background.
